name: Flow Video
description: Plans a brief (plus optional reference images) into a multi-scene storyboard with a continuity sheet, makes consistent scene stills and Kling/Seedance clips (text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last frame, multi-reference, continuous one-take), adds voice-over and music, edits on a timeline (trim, captions, fades, audio mix, camera moves) and exports an MP4.

execution.service_target: engines/story_engine.py (flow_video planner + models, run inside Palette-Video)

invocation.note: No broker service; every step is async (poll GET /generations/{id} or SSE). The end-to-end chain is driven by the app's own browser UI.

video.image_to_video.reason: needs a start frame image to animate

edit.trim_and_cut.reason: trims clips placed on its timeline

best_for: multi-scene AI films from a brief (ads, stories, explainers, travel, food, fashion, music videos), 3-120 s
consistent characters, products, garments and locations from reference images
single AI clips with first/last frame control
voice-over, music and burned-in captions, exported to MP4
AI-filmed product animation and exploded views (parts separating in mid-air, real footage, not a diagram)
realistic explainers and ads with AI footage plus labels, arrows, measurements and creator/explainer effects added on top by the engine
not_good_for: recreating a reference video (only its first frame is read)
upscaling, denoising or colour-grading existing footage
profile_notes: From source v0.0.35 (read 2026-11-13). Clip models Kling 3.0/O3/4.0 (<=30 s), Seedance 2.0/2.5; film 3-120 s. Transitions: cut or fade only. Music instrumental only. Runs as an engine inside Palette-Video (the app's own planner prompt and models, vendored); its own screens are not used. Exploded views and product animation added 2026-11-13 as AI footage (unverified). 2026-11-13: the engine adds graphics (Motion Studio overlay) and effects (Effects Studio) itself when they help. Inside VideoStudio the engine does not trim footage or add transitions (hard cuts only): those are 'unknown' so the router never promises them.
